extracted.name: Pizza salad flatbreads
extracted.description: Pack classic pizza flavours into a salad, then use as a topping for flatbreads. Quick and easy to make, they're full of big flavours and textures
ingredient_lines: 2 roasted peppers drained and roughly chopped
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Sprinkle the flatbreads with a little water and heat in the oven for 4-5 mins until soft and warm, then set aside to cool slightly.
Combine all the dressing ingredients in a large bowl and season to taste. Mix in all the salad ingredients, tossing well to coat in the dressing, then arrange on top of the flatbreads to serve.
